method: CPU-only pinned-image source inspection; no model requests or vLLM configuration changes
findings: B12X_W4A16_A4_PREFILL=1 enables hybrid NVFP4 activation prefill within the W4A16 family; VLLM_B12X_MOE_FP4_FORCE_A16=1 does not disable this policy.
B12X dispatcher requires prepared A4 calibration scales and scheduler-owned prefill spans; absent metadata and capture contexts can fall back to A16.
Configured V2 runner builds MoEPrefillMetadata. TP/DCP are supported by the validated policy; DP/PCP/EP and sequence parallelism are rejected.
TensorFold pinned native prefill_rows is 2048; supplied vLLM max_num_batched_tokens is 4096. These settings have different scheduler meanings.
inference: Hybrid A4 prefill and batching are plausible contributors to the cross-engine speed gap, not quantitatively established causes. Same checkpoint and prompts do not imply the same activation arithmetic.
limits: No GPU trace proves coverage of every dispatched prefill kernel. No A4-on/off causal ablation was run. TensorFold resident CSF32 remains BF16 activation W4A16; adding A4 would require separate quality qualification.
